findings.desc: A 15-second gate would also invoke the platform intake drain four times more often.
Outcome-unknown reconciliation would reread the complete control Issue every 15 seconds.
Transient GitHub failures and full scans of a large control Issue could consume the API budget and create durable attention.
A crash could leave the directory lock behind and make every later tick silently return single_flight_busy forever.
Persisted Codex sessions lacked bounded retention and duplicated the successful run transcript.
A persisted automation session could be manually resumed after its wake was consumed and attempt the work again.
The implementation did not validate the visibility assumption that codexHome is the Desktop session home.
The cadence test asserted literal plist bytes rather than the model-free behavior.
The negative ephemeral assertion did not prove a persistent thread identity or lifecycle.
A long synchronous AI job coalesces launchd ticks and would also block the combined intake drain.
Fifteen-second launchd stdout and stderr files had no rotation bound.
The activation checklist did not prove 15-second behavior, stale-lock handling, or IDE visibility without liveness coupling.
